proof_scope.written: Identify the disk-exterior boundary by the zero longitude; prove contractibility from the degree plus/minus one attaching map in the handle-core CW model.
proof_scope.inputs: Tubular neighbourhoods, linking/intersection interpretation, and handle-core homotopy model.

proof_scope.written: Derive the normal-closure quotient and boundary-normal-generation gluing argument from van Kampen.
proof_scope.inputs: Theorem 2012 is cited from Hatcher; its general proof is not supplied.

proof_scope.written: Euler characteristic and Betti-number calculations, including the surface-bundle product argument and b2=10 before surgery, b2=2 afterward, double-handle b2=2k and combined b2=6.
proof_scope.inputs: Mayer-Vietoris and Poincare duality are explicitly linked. The topological properties of the particular input blocks are cited separately.

proof_scope.written: Kernel/image proof for a cyclic exact sequence with zero third term; basis proof for a nondegenerate pairing of one-dimensional vector spaces.
proof_scope.inputs: No Floer triangle or geometric pairing theorem is proved by these algebraic arguments.

proof_scope.written: Glue a boundary-compatible homeomorphism with the identity and construct its inverse.
proof_scope.inputs: Freedman's topological extension theorem for contractible four-manifolds; the cork structure theorem remains cited.

proof_scope.written: Explicit radial inversion sends a compact disk in the standard exterior into the punctured ball; explain the slicing contradiction.
proof_scope.inputs: Extension of S3 diffeomorphisms across B4, including an orientation-reversing reflection reduction; open four-manifold smoothing compatible with the boundary and the survey's puncture/removal comparison. 200C is explicitly a proof outline.

proof_scope.written: Compute the signs for CP2 and its reverse, the connected-sum orthogonal sum, and the hyperbolic form of S2xS2.
proof_scope.inputs: Projective-space CW model, transverse geometric intersection and Mayer-Vietoris.

proof_scope.written: After imposing the fibre normal closure, the two meridians and then the two base generators vanish.
proof_scope.inputs: LP Lemma 5 supplies the actual geometric generators and commutator relations; homology and symplectic assertions, the surgery-curve positions, and Lemma 9 nonvanishing remain cited.

proof_scope.written: Explain the complete logical assembly: simple connectivity, rank and form, topological classification, nonzero one-dimensional pairing, transport of the fixed null-square class, and contradiction with a sphere representative.
proof_scope.inputs: LLP Proposition 6.9; LP Lemmas 9-10 and Theorem 3; Freedman classification; integer intersection-form classification; Wall realization and sphere-basis construction; Floer sphere vanishing. This is a proof with cited deep inputs, not an independent reconstruction of those inputs.

normalization_and_corrections: Correct section 3.3: a genus-two bundle over a genus-two surface with b1=4 has chi=4 and b2=10, not b2=2. The value two applies after the surgeries kill b1; 200J supplies the calculation and is linked from 200L.

Use Spin-c structures for SW labels, expected dimension zero and the closed symplectic b2+>1 version of Taubes nonvanishing. Retain chamber dependence when b2+=1; do not transfer the survey's schematic H2-to-Z/2 notation without qualifications.
Use reduced Heegaard Floer homology in the vanishing claim for S1xS2, distinguish the minus/infinity/plus inputs, and split relative invariants into 2014. HF-minus(S3) is nonzero.

For b2+=1 mixed invariants retain the null-square line L and non-torsion boundary Spin-c restriction. The final argument uses Wall realization and a sphere obstruction for this fixed L, not an unqualified symplectic nonvanishing statement.
Say that the standard CP2 connected-sum topology supports nonstandard smooth structures; never label the selected standard smooth connected sum itself exotic.

Keep relative cork nonextendability distinct from absolute nondiffeomorphism. The Mazur construction uses unknotted boundary-parallel disks and linking number one; contractibility does not by itself distinguish smooth types.

Separate zero Dehn surgery (2013) from the four-dimensional zero trace (2006), and fundamental class (2010) from Poincare duality (2011). Reuse the parent's ring-coefficient extensions 0BLY and 0F55 rather than duplicate integral definitions.
Use cohomology S2xS2, not homeomorphic S2xS2, for LP Theorem 8. Its smooth distinction uses symplectic Kodaira dimension; its fundamental group is not established to be trivial.
Use Euler characteristic and duality to prove the gluing ranks rather than assert an unjustified direct sum of the pieces' H2.

The LP Theorem 3 proof contains a displayed comparison with S2xS2 connected-summed with three reversed CP2 factors, inconsistent with rank six. The notes do not reproduce that expression; they use the six-dimensional intersection matrix and the precise standard CP2#5CPbar2 comparison. Likewise Wall realization concerns isometries of the intersection form, not arbitrary abelian-group automorphisms.

Historical year/attribution shortcuts in the survey and LLP introduction differ for the CP2#9 and CP2#2 examples; the notes avoid unverified priority/year claims and cite the construction actually used.

Keep SW/HF equivalence and the smooth four-dimensional Poincare question conjectural. Add orientation-reversing boundary-map reduction in 200B, replace the ambiguous five-dimensional-homology phrase in 2000 by second homology rank five, and replace orthogonal point by positive-sign intersection point in 200E.

Reuse existing 00E0, 00E2, 0116, 00G4, 00BF, 0118, 00FP and 0BL1 links where they decode the prose; remove forbidden TeX negative thin space from 200H. Move proof-accounting language out of reader-facing mathematical prose.
deferred: Full proofs of Smale/Wall/Freedman/Donaldson results, cork localization and extension, Akbulut-Ruberman absolute exotica, open four-manifold smoothing, and the S3 extension theorem remain cited.

SW analytic construction and Taubes nonvanishing, Luttinger symplectic preservation, symplectic Kodaira dimension and its surgery invariance, HF chain complexes, cobordism maps, surgery triangles, duality and adjunction/sphere vanishing are not reconstructed. The reduced and relative HF notes specify the data needed here, not a foundational Floer course.

Independent diagram-by-diagram reconstruction of the Mazur link, the Q_n pretzel handle chain, LLP Proposition 6.9, LP surgery tori and boundary involution remains undone; publisher PDF screenshots were unavailable.

The rational homology four-sphere quotient, figure-eight slicing distinction, the odd cohomology CP2#CPbar2 variant and their Arf/Spin arguments from LP Theorems 1-2 were read but not developed into separate branches in this batch.

No resolution of the fundamental group of the cohomology S2xS2 model, no exotic standard S2xS2 claim, no smooth four-dimensional Poincare solution, and no proof of the conjectured closed SW/HF equivalence.
